title: Barber story: contractor and mercenary retrieval units competing
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Barber story: contractor and mercenary retrieval units competing, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: also would explain the whole weird parts of the barber story where it's implies there's like contractor teams and mercenary you know you know like retrieval units all kind of competing over this stuff.

plain: An analyst named Matthew Pines, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, discusses the account of Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped retrieve a UFO. Pines says Barber's story implies that private contractor teams and mercenary retrieval units are competing with each other to recover these objects. He offers this as one of the stranger parts of the story that his own wider view would explain.
